question: By what power does the yoginī named Icchā extend up to the limit of māyā?
premises: She is associated with the siddhas
Her reach extends up to māyā by supreme will
inference: The yoginī Icchā, with the siddhas, extends up to māyā through supreme will.
uncertainties: The exact syntactic relation of siddhaiḥ is ambiguous
plain_english: The yoginī named Icchā, with the siddhas, reaches up to māyā by supreme will.
